scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “An exponential two-way deterministic state lower bound for one-way liveness” (preprints/An-exponential-two-way-deterministic-state-lower-bound-for-one-way-liveness-September-25-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 129 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 612819217a292910), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every integer h ≥ 2, the language OWLh is recognized by a nondeterministic automaton with h+3 states using no left moves. Every equivalent deterministic two-way automaton with s states satisfies 4(s + 2)2 ≥ 2⌊(h−2)/31⌋ . (1.2) If an initially accepting configuration counts as acceptance, s + 2 in (1.2) may be replaced by s + 1.
